# Ad Monetization Tracker

> Ad Monetization Tracker is a free iPhone app that shows the earnings of your own Google AdMob and Google AdSense accounts: revenue, eCPM, impressions, clicks, countries, ad formats, apps and sites, a daily calendar, a monthly goal and an estimated payment balance, plus home screen widgets. You sign in with Google on the device with read-only access; the app has no server and no account of its own. Published by Albea Systems. Not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Google.

## Key facts

- Platform: iPhone and iPad, iOS 17 or later. No Android version.
- Price: free with ads. A one-time in-app purchase (Pro) removes ads and unlocks alerts and PDF or CSV reports; a rewarded video gives one hour without ads.
- Data: Google AdMob API and AdSense Management API, read-only, requested by the app on the device. Figures are estimates that Google finalises at month end; the payment balance is an app estimate.
- Sample data: the app works without an account on built-in sample data.
- Languages of the app and of this site: English, Español, Français, Italiano, Deutsch, Português, العربية, 简体中文, हिन्दी, 日本語, 한국어, Tiếng Việt.
- Download: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6835190761
- Contact: albeasystems@gmail.com
